_info: Atlas Mapper - naming preset: texture identification rules used by the folder scan.

One preset = one .json file of the naming_presets folder; its name (without .json) appears in the 'Naming convention' list. To create a preset, copy this file, rename the copy and edit it. To delete one, delete its file.
Edit this file freely, then click 'Scan folder' again.
File names are converted to lowercase before comparison: write keywords in lowercase.
A keyword is a SUFFIX: it must be at the very end of the file name, just before the extension.
If several keywords match, the longest one wins (e.g. '_basecolor' before '_bc').
A keyword can only belong to one texture format.

packed_formats: one file holding several maps, one per channel. 'suffixes' works like texture_formats; R / G / B name the map stored in that channel (a name from texture_formats). Omit a channel if it is unused.
A map found both as its own file and inside a packed file: its own file wins, for that map only.
glossiness (= Unity smoothness) is an inverted roughness. If an asset has both, roughness wins. mods = Unity HDRP Mask Map, ms = Unity URP / Standard Metallic map with smoothness in A.
asset_prefixes: removed from the START of asset names (file or subfolder). Longest first, one only. Leave [] to keep names unchanged.
